purpose: Fictional geography as maps, routes, distances, borders, and place relationships that shape a particular narrative world and its versions.

Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
State the fictional work and edition. Treat maps as versioned creative artifacts rather than complete or physically exact surveys; attribute real-world references.
